اعتليتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَلَيْتُمْ (iʕtalaytum) /iʕ.ta.laj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اُعْتُلِيتُمْ (uʕtulītum) /uʕ.tu.liː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
